title: The threshold for linear independence of multiple zeta values in positive characteristic
summary: A fundamental conjecture formulated by Thakur in 2009, which has guided significant developments in function field arithmetic, asserts that multiple zeta values (MZV's) in positive characteristic of fixed weight are linearly independent over $\mathbb{F}_q$. In this paper we settle this conjecture by determining the precise threshold for this independence. We prove that linear independence holds for all weights up to 2q, while for weight 2q+1 we establish the existence of a unique and explicit $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear relation.
